title: Fit calibrated evidence models

raw_evidence_families: global prototype, nearest-reference and top-k similarities
family similarity, rank and raw margin
local prototype, nearest-reference and top-k similarities
absolute global/local disagreement and rank movement
route, visual domain and route compatibility
global/local support coverage, counts, independence and shortfall
query tier, hit count, text similarity and text margin
feature_contract.missingness_semantics: raw null plus an explicit availability indicator, followed by deterministic model-vector zero fill
feature_contract.label_boundary: human_supported is retained for supervised evaluation but excluded from feature_names and feature_vector
feature_contract.split_binding: exact complete join to one validated frozen split manifest

properties: each OOF estimator excludes every row in its held-out independence component
the sigmoid calibrator sees OOF calibration logits rather than full-fit logits
the transparent runtime persists feature order, scaler mean/scale, coefficients and intercept
validation labels affect diagnostics but not model or calibrator fingerprints
changing final-test feature values does not alter the fit, validation predictions or fit fingerprint

threshold_contract.selection_objective: maximum weighted validation coverage among passing thresholds
threshold_contract.component_success_semantics: every selected row in an independence component must be human supported

first_party_basis: BioMiner grouped OOF sigmoid calibration runtime

allowed: Task 10.2 mechanically separates feature values, calibration fitting, independent validation diagnostics and untouched final-test evidence.
The deterministic fixture produces finite calibrated probabilities and reproducible reliability metrics.
Threshold selection uses a configured conservative precision lower bound and fails closed when evidence or the bound is insufficient.
An audited threshold can label only statistically_supported_screening_candidate and cannot authorize occurrence release.
blocked: The synthetic fixture metrics estimate live Flickr performance or generalization.
The demonstration 0.50 lower-bound policy is the production 0.95 policy.
A threshold selected on 11 fixture validation rows is ready for production use.
Calibration, statistical screening support or a model score replaces decisive human review for occurrence release.
Final-test performance has been measured or used for Task 10.2 decisions.

live_and_human_work_remaining: populate the frozen feature table from source-bound live reviewed Flickr evidence
fit each supported production route only after its calibration and validation evidence floors are met
keep final-test labels locked until the preregistered final evaluation gate
complete decisive human review and all occurrence-release gates independently of screening
